Position Summary 		   Reporting to:  Head   of  Learning Assistant   and  Student Affairs
Department:  Academic Operation
Contract Type:  Full-Time / On-site
Working Day:  Monday   to  Friday & Saturday Morning
Working Hours:  8:00 am – 5:00 pm & 8:00 am – 12:00 pm
Role Overview:  The   Office  Intern   will  support   the  operation   and  academic Department.   This  role offers hands-on experience   in  education administration, communication,   and  data management, dealing   with  students   and  teachers, administrative   work  and academic support.
Duties & Responsibilities:
•  Key Responsibilities:
•  Managing filing system.
•  Recording information   as  needed.
•  Updating paperwork, maintaining documents,   and  word processing.
•  Helping organize   and  maintain   office  common areas.
•  Performing general   office  clerk duties   and  errands.
•  Coordinating events   as  necessary.
•  Maintaining supply inventory.
•  Maintaining   office  equipment   as  needed.
•  Experience   as  a virtual assistant.
•  Creating, maintaining,   and  entering information into databases.
•  Report Preparation:
•  Prepare   and  Submit weekly reports   to  Head   of  Learning Assistant   and  Student Affairs
Benefits:
•  Gain insight into administrative   work  and   work  ethics
•  Develop   professional  skills   in  project management   and  data analysis
•  Network   with  professionals   and  staff
•  Mention   any  perks: flexible hours, mentorship, travel opportunities, etc.
Expected Profile of Candidates
Qualifications:
•  Undergraduate Degree   in  Relevant field
•  Bachelor's Degree
Skills & Knowledge:
General & Technical Skills
•  Detail-oriented   with  basic   data  management   or  administrative experience
•  Proficiency   in  MS Office/G-Suite, CRM tools,   or  social media   is  a plus.
Soft Skills
•  Strong communication   skills  (written   and  verbal)
•  Comfortable interacting   with  diverse audiences
•  Passion   for  higher education   and  student success
